name: anudeep-khadi-bandar-billing
description: Direct WhatsApp 1-Click Send on Mobile/Web & Guaranteed Accurate Bot State
releaseNotes: 1. Direct 1-click WhatsApp sending on Mobile and Web with pre-filled bill and instant wa.me deep-link. 2. Heartbeat expiration check in Supabase prevents false 'connected' status when host PC is offline. 3. Fixed KeepAlive loop in server.js to prevent browser crash and memory leaks. 4. Automatic Share modal trigger on invoice creation when host bot is offline. 5. Sequential message dispatch (text first, then PDF) for 100% reliable WhatsApp delivery.
